subject: procedural materials
outcome: Original seeded procedural grain, marble-inspired roughness and a low-poly stone landscape are generated at runtime with no external surface downloads.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Use rights-cleared materials with plausible roughness, joints and surface variation
Avoid surface details that suggest unsupported survey accuracy
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: Material colors are artistic interpretation rather than archaeological pigment measurements.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
